measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 1% city sales tax for infrastructure, public facilities and utilities, streets, parks and recreation, capital projects and repayment of bonds for those purposes. Collection would start April 1, 2027, or as soon afterward as the law allows. The tax would continue until the city repeals it.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the 1% sales tax for these purposes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this sales tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Extends Nickerson’s existing 1% city sales tax for five years, from April 1, 2027, through March 31, 2032. It could pay for parks, streets, sewer repairs, sidewalks, city appearance, tornado sirens and property tax relief.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Extend the existing 1% sales tax for these five years and purposes.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this five-year extension of the sales tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the city to borrow up to $500,000 through general-obligation bonds to pave and improve East Snokomo Road, West Snokomo Road, Crazy Horse Road and Northlinks Drive, and make related improvements.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $500,000 in bonds for these street improvements.
